visual_goal: Show a lookup passing a row of defense layers, cheapest first, with a walk detector watching usage outcomes and feeding throttle decisions back to the gateway.
prompt: A strictly linear left-to-right row of six icons joined by single arrows, each icon with its own label directly beneath it. Icon one: a generic laptop with a phone, label beneath 'Caller'. Icon two: a plain shield with no symbol, label beneath 'Edge'. Icon three: a turnstile, label beneath 'Gateway'. Icon four: a clipboard with ticks, label beneath 'Purpose check'. Icon five: a meter dial, label beneath 'Quota and spend'. Icon six: an outbox tray, label beneath 'Response composer'. Six icons and six labels, one label per icon. Below the row, an eye-shaped radar box, label beneath 'Walk detector'. One dashed arrow from the meter dial down into the eye box, labeled 'usage events'. One dashed arrow from the eye box up into the turnstile, labeled 'throttle'.
alt: A caller's lookup passes the edge, gateway, purpose check, quota and spend meter and response composer; usage events feed a walk detector that sends throttle decisions back to the gateway.

visual_goal: Show the scoped credential lifecycle: sandbox before production, suspension as a normal reversible state, revocation as the end.
prompt: A simple state map of five rounded tiles with small key icons. Far left: blue 'Sandbox' with a toy car icon. Center: large green 'Production'. Upper right: teal 'Rotated'. Lower center: orange 'Suspended' with a pause icon. Far right: red 'Revoked'. Exactly seven arrows: one from 'Sandbox' to 'Production' labeled 'contract'; one from 'Production' down to 'Suspended' labeled 'suspicion'; one from 'Suspended' back up to 'Production' labeled 'rotated key'; one from 'Production' to 'Rotated'; one from 'Rotated' back to 'Production'; one from 'Suspended' to 'Revoked' labeled 'leak confirmed'; one from 'Production' to 'Revoked' labeled 'contract ends'.
alt: A credential moves from Sandbox to Production after a contract; Production can be suspended on suspicion and resumed with a rotated key, rotated on schedule, or revoked when a leak is confirmed or the contract ends.

visual_goal: Show Axleby's security zones: separate cells, a shared data platform, an isolated adapter zone that reaches partners only through an egress proxy, a separate register gateway, and an isolated backup vault.
prompt: A top-to-bottom zone diagram of fenced rounded areas. Top: a group of generic people with laptops labeled 'Dealers and clients', one arrow down to a gate labeled 'API gateway'. Middle row, left to right: a fenced box 'EU cell', a fenced box 'UK cell', each receiving one arrow from 'API gateway'. Bottom row, directly below the two cells: on the left a wide box labeled 'Data platform', on the right a fenced box labeled 'Adapter zone'. 'EU cell' has two arrows going straight down or diagonally down: one to 'Data platform' and one to 'Adapter zone'. 'UK cell' has two arrows going down: one to 'Data platform' and one to 'Adapter zone'. No arrow passes through any box. From 'Adapter zone', one arrow right to a narrow door labeled 'Egress proxy', then one arrow from 'Egress proxy' to generic external buildings labeled 'Partners'. Below 'Data platform', one arrow down to a fenced box labeled 'Register gateway'. In the bottom-left corner, completely separate with no arrows, a locked vault labeled 'Backup vault'.
alt: Dealers reach an API gateway that feeds separate EU and UK cells; cells use a shared data platform and an isolated adapter zone that reaches partners only through an egress proxy; the register gateway is its own zone and the backup vault stands apart.
